name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 10 – Am 53
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 10a. Calls on the European Central Bank, the Commission, the Central Bank of Ireland and the Central Bank of Luxembourg to end the sale of Israeli war bonds within the EU under the Prospectus Regulation, as these bonds provide direct financial support to Israel’s occupation and genocide;
